source.read_mode: SQLite mode=ro, query_only, one read transaction including WAL

scope: Curated representative contracts and their actual linked current contracts; not an exhaustive exchange listing.
notes: Catalog presence establishes identity only. Consult actual feed results for availability.
Continuous contracts and dated contracts are distinct instruments; roll and back-adjustment policies are not inferred.
Bitcoin reference assets, spot pairs, and CME futures are labeled separately; no fund/ETF substitutes are used.
Use ID.<stock_id> for unambiguous access, especially when different venues share a spot-pair code.
